retention_families: each R0-R3: state/heldout x defect/source_error, offsets0/3/6/9
calibration: component means and sample SD(ddof=1) estimated from fresh same-law calibration draws, then frozen before rescoring unchanged inferential banks
family_rank: +1 empirical exceedance rank for sum and minimum over3 synchronized components using original1024 inferential draws
component_and_maxT_tests: remain byte-identical to Referee05; calibration is ONLY for sum/minimum
sampling: direct IID draws; same source/endpoint/degree/matching constraints and rejection laws as Referee05, no chains or early stopping
decisions: ROBUSTNESS_PRESERVED; FAMILY_RESULT_WEAKENED if only one formerly-supported family statistic survives; FAMILY_RESULT_LOST if neither survives
finite_methods_audit: direct definitions and cardinalities only; no new inferential test or threshold selection
